answer: Make every account hold an exclusive, slowly earned asset: a route in a shared map. Agents draft an atlas of who actually paid whom for delivered work, and each new edge needs a real counterparty who also risks part of its stake on that claim. A farm can mint keys but its edges all lead back into its own cluster, so a flow cut around that cluster caps total rewards at what outsiders really paid in. Treat old standing as a relic unless fresh payments renew it, and treat scores like ferrous metal: left unused, they rust away within weeks.
